scope: All53 compact payload preservation plus actual installed-client registry/denial preflight; no scored agent calls

checks: all individual report rows equal aggregate entries
original and reconstructed base/A/B commits and trees match locked dataset
every current source/ref/index fingerprint equals recorded before and after
saved full reviews reproduce exact full/compact response hashes and UTF-8 byte counts
default full-read hashes and persistent-review hashes unchanged
published payload report JSON-equivalent to audited raw report after formatting
payload.publishedNormalization: Prettier JSON formatting only; independently verified parsed JSON is identical to the original raw report. reportSha256 covers the unformatted raw report; publishedFileSha256 covers the formatted published file.

checks: all8 registry/boundary raw request hashes match published summaries
both arms effective tools exactly match source-only whitelist; Fuse adds only inspect/review
both first-request inputs omit skill/AGENTS/evaluator sentinel context
both forced patch attempts return read-only rejection
both forced goal attempts require persistent thread
boundary probe source hash matches report; passing probe asserts before/after source fingerprint equality
source-only agent and source-server code byte-identical between canary copy and final candidate
published summaries byte-identical to audited originals

limitations: Synthetic-provider canaries verify controls; they are not scored model runs.
Some denied builtin attempts are absent from native action events; inspect captured function result for the denial.
No new native UI acceptance or scored study audit is established by these checks.
